name: BottomSheet
summary: The panel that rises from the bottom of the phone, with the grabber, the drag to close and a 32 corner. Native only; on the web, Drawer side="bottom".

a11y.apg: A modal dialog for the screen reader, named by its title. Back on Android and the swipe down close it.

props.name: title
props.description: The sheet's title, which names it for the screen reader.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called when the person closes it: the drag down, the backdrop, Back.

props.name: grabber
props.description: Shows the small bar at the top that says it can be dragged.

props.name: draggable
props.description: Lets the person drag it down to close.

props.name: scroll
props.description: Makes the content scroll inside the sheet.
